During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a '''weak-minded individual''' visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Inside" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While there,<ref name="Inside" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] cultist<ref name="db">{{DB|character|nyratagira|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref> [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] identified the individual for conversion to the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]], a fast-growing,<ref name="Inside" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]-empowering<ref name="Far Horizons2">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref> cult.<ref name="Inside" />

While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] interrogated the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] outside the club, the individual moved away from the bar with Agira. While at the Outlander Club, the individual wore a [[Color/Legends|light blue]] [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]], black shoes, and a white headband. A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], the individual had light skin and blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Inside" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The weak-minded individual was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', which was written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside" /> The character was illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref>
